notes.title: Vote for the Next Level You Want to See!
notes.content:
We want YOU to decide which new level will be added to BEATRECT! Your vote will directly shape the future of the game. Whether you're looking for a challenge or a fun rhythm experience, your opinion matters.

[h2]How to Participate?[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Join our Discord:[/b]
https://discord.com/invite/2qXxK2nNzJ

Head over to the #events channel and post your vote.

[*][b]Use the Google Form:[/b]
https://discord.com/invite/2qXxK2nNzJ

You can also submit your vote and level suggestions through our Google Form link. (You can suggest your favorite songs and choose your preferred difficulty level!)
[/list]

[h2]Event Guidelines[/h2]

The voting period is open from November to December 31, 2024.
All participants will be considered for community shoutouts in upcoming updates.
Stay tuned for future events and content additions based on YOUR feedback!


[h2]How to Vote?[/h2]

Simply follow the steps on our Discord channel or use the Google Form provided to cast your vote and submit level suggestions.
Voting is quick, easy, and helps bring new content to BEATRECT based on community favorites.
We can't wait to see what YOU choose! Get voting now and help shape the future of BEATRECT!
